boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Michigan-Dearborn
boards.description: Ten currently listed food and coffee destinations in Dearborn with late evening or overnight hours, each supported by a direct business source.

cards.title: Hot&Puff
cards.subtitle: 14651 Michigan Ave, Dearborn
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s online ordering or pickup option when you need food after an evening campus commitment.
cards.short_summary: American comfort-food restaurant with pickup and delivery listed on its site.
cards.evidence_claim: Hot&Puff lists daily business hours ending at 3:00 AM and identifies its location as 14651 Michigan Avenue in Dearborn.
cards.access_notes: The business lists Sunday 1 PM–3 AM and Monday–Saturday hours ending at 3 AM; pickup and delivery are listed.

cards.title: Mocha Delights
cards.subtitle: 14456 Michigan Ave, Dearborn
cards.notes: Plan a carryout stop for coffee, smoothies, sandwiches, or other listed menu categories before heading home.
cards.short_summary: Mediterranean-inspired café with late business and carryout hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Mocha Delights lists 14456 Michigan Ave in Dearborn and business hours through 3:00 AM Monday–Saturday and 1:00 AM Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed business hours are 5 PM–3 AM Monday–Saturday and 5 PM–1 AM Sunday; carryout closes 30 minutes earlier.

cards.title: Fratelli's Eatery
cards.subtitle: 5960 Schaefer Rd, Suite A, Dearborn
cards.notes: Check the day before going: the Dearborn location’s listed closing time extends later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Pizza, sandwiches, seafood, and appetizers at the Dearborn location.
cards.evidence_claim: Fratelli's lists its Dearborn location at 5960 Schaefer Rd, Suite A, with hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed Dearborn hours: 2 PM–12 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2 PM–2 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: DQ Grill & Chill
cards.subtitle: 4600 Greenfield Rd, Dearborn
cards.notes: Use the listed drive-thru, dine-in, curbside, or delivery availability for a late food or treat stop.
cards.short_summary: Chain restaurant with food, treats, and multiple service modes listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Dairy Queen’s official location page lists the 4600 Greenfield Rd Dearborn restaurant open until 12:00 AM every day, including dine-in and drive-thru.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists store, drive-thru, dine-in, curbside, and delivery hours of 10:30 AM–12 AM daily.

cards.title: Burger Mix
cards.subtitle: 7021 Wyoming St, Dearborn
cards.notes: Confirm availability before leaving, then use the official ordering link for a burger or milkshake pickup.
cards.short_summary: Burger and milkshake restaurant with a daily late closing time listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Burger Mix’s official Dearborn page lists 7021 Wyoming St and states it is open seven days from 8 AM to 2 AM.
cards.access_notes: The official site states: open seven days, 8 AM–2 AM.

cards.entity_name: Level Zero Smash Burgers — West Dearborn
cards.title: Level Zero Smash Burgers
cards.subtitle: West Dearborn · 22224 Michigan Ave
cards.notes: Use the West Dearborn location page to confirm the address, then order or get directions from its official links.
cards.short_summary: West Dearborn smash-burger location with daily hours through 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Level Zero’s official locations page lists its West Dearborn restaurant at 22224 Michigan Ave and daily hours of 11 AM–2 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official locations page lists the West Dearborn location as open every day from 11 AM to 2 AM.

cards.entity_name: Level Zero Smash Burgers — East Dearborn
cards.title: Level Zero Smash Burgers — East
cards.subtitle: East Dearborn · 6914 Wyoming Ave
cards.notes: Use the East Dearborn listing when its Wyoming Avenue address is more convenient for your route.
cards.short_summary: Separate East Dearborn smash-burger location with daily late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Level Zero’s official locations page lists its East Dearborn restaurant at 6914 Wyoming Ave and daily hours of 11 AM–2 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official locations page lists the East Dearborn location as open every day from 11 AM to 2 AM.

cards.title: Qimmah Coffee House
cards.subtitle: 939 Howard St, Dearborn
cards.notes: Choose this coffee-house stop when you need a nonalcoholic evening option; verify the day’s closing time first.
cards.short_summary: Coffee house with midnight weekday and 1 AM weekend hours listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Qimmah Coffee House lists 939 Howard St in Dearborn, with hours until midnight Monday–Thursday and 1:00 AM Friday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 8 AM–12 AM Monday–Thursday and 8 AM–1 AM Friday–Sunday.

cards.title: Farooj
cards.subtitle: 10386 W Warren Ave, Dearborn
cards.notes: Check the official menu page for the current day’s window before making this W Warren Avenue food run.
cards.short_summary: Dearborn restaurant whose official menu page lists late nightly hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Farooj’s official menu page lists its address as 10386 W Warren Ave, Dearborn, and shows hours through 1:00 AM on Monday.
cards.access_notes: The official menu page lists Monday hours of 12 PM–1 AM; confirm the current day’s hours before travel.

cards.title: The Canteen at Midtown
cards.subtitle: 720 Town Center Dr, Dearborn
cards.notes: Use Friday or Saturday for the latest listed hours, and check the business page for current vendors before you go.
cards.short_summary: Midtown Dearborn food destination with weekend hours through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The Canteen at Midtown lists 720 Town Center Dr in Dearborn and hours until 12:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 11 AM–12 AM Friday, 12 PM–12 AM Saturday; other days close earlier.
